# Bundled FFprobe

FFprobe 9.0.2 is built from unmodified FFmpeg sources under LGPL-2.1-or-later, without GPL/nonfree components or external codec libraries. MinGW runtime notices are included separately.

The exact source and build materials are supplied as **Photo-Pinboard-1.0.0-ffprobe-sources.zip** alongside the Windows download at:

https://github.com/blissfulsaint/photo-pinboard/releases/tag/v1.0.0

Source archive SHA-256: fdba86b9e5be944701ef473cc0bd642211e319d5d398fa95b18bed77c5587a4a

Binary SHA-256: bff6afa843a2198ad16588c758c1b16d51ba4dc9d5b432e2bd0c374ad6694fc3

The archive includes FFmpeg sources, compiler/runtime sources, build recipes, configuration and provenance. See toolchain.json and BUILDINFO.txt. Photo Pinboard's original code retains its MIT license.
